recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-34397; future changes to capabilitystatement-expectation contexts should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack and coordinated with later FHIR-extensions trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-34397 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core R5 change request asking that capabilitystatement-search-parameter-combination allow capabilitystatement-expectation so guides can express SHALL, SHOULD, MAY, etc. for a search parameter combination.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied to R5 core source by commit 8134deab96, which added a context of type extension for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/capabilitystatement-search-parameter-combination to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-extension-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml. The commit subject names FHIR-24297, an unrelated PAS issue, but the diff and branch history match this tracker family.
additional_context: The old core extension-definition source files were removed by dd468d4f17 when R5 extensions moved out of core. The active definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack at input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml and still contains the requested extension context. The current published Extension Pack JSON also exposes the same context. FHIR-28103 is related background for broader expectation contexts, while later FHIR-46192 and FHIR-56196 refined other contexts without removing this one.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current FHIR core checkout has no active build-scope source file for these extension definitions, and the authoritative Extension Pack source/published artifact already satisfies the Jira request.
